title: CXCR4 regulates extra-medullary myeloma through epithelial-mesenchymal transition-like transcriptional activation
description: We have developed EMD- and BM-prone and defined the presence of an EMT-like mRNA signature in both EMD- and BM-prone clones. Overall design: Evaluation of RNA sequencing of EMD- and BM-prone clones as compared to the parental cells the two clones were originated from.
